We understand Denver's pace and professional expectations—whether you're balancing full-time work at a Fortune 500 employer or managing your own career transition, our flexible scheduling accommodates working professionals. Upon completion, you'll hold a credential recognized globally and valued locally by the organizations that drive Denver's economy, positioning you for roles with greater responsibility and earning potential in your field.

content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Denver

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—secondary degree holders and bachelor's degree holders face different thresholds. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify whether your current role and credentials align with PMI standards.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course designed for working professionals. Our Denver-based instructors deliver real-world case studies and interactive sessions across multiple weeknight and weekend sessions. Upon completion, you'll receive the formal education certificate required by PMI to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your training hours, create your PMI account and submit your official PMP application, including your work history and education documentation. Pay the exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy's team can guide you through the online portal to ensure your application is complete and accurate.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides targeted exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and review sessions to strengthen your readiness. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner at a local Denver testing center. Our instructors remain available to clarify concepts before exam day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) every three years during your renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible workshops and online courses. Staying current keeps your credential active and deepens your expertise in a competitive Denver job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.

fq_items.question: Is PMP certification worth it for Denver aerospace and defense careers?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Lockheed Martin and other major aerospace employers in the Denver region actively seek certified project managers to lead complex, regulated programs. PMP certification signals standardized competency in scope, schedule, and risk management—skills essential in defense contracting. Certification often leads to faster advancement and eligibility for higher-responsibility roles managing large-budget initiatives.

Financial services and renewable energy employers in the Denver area also prioritize the credential. Many local roles treat certification as a differentiator when candidates are otherwise similar.
